items.text: Name the three temporal perspectives frame: History (past, historian) / Development (present, memory-kit+converge+shift) / Roadmap (future, converge->roadmap-walker) as views on one substrate (the epic-graph over time)
Epic-graph as substrate: git log --follow on epic.md is a first-class timeline data source; cross-references become a traversable graph; next epic computable from trajectory
Historian surface agent: archive indexing, pattern-signature extraction, continuous comparison during planning, surface annotation on match (context not notification); inverse of cleanup
Pattern signature schema per archived entry: trigger conditions / outcome class / decision frame / adjacent themes (resolved by MemPalace embeddings)
Vertical wisdom-compaction lifecycle: chat -> memory entries -> epic paragraphs -> manifesto principles; wisdom as the asymptote each tier reaches toward
Future primitive promote-to-epic: cluster of memory entries -> drafted epic paragraph, sources marked compacted-into-epic; lossy-by-design; needs its own design pass
Adopt MemPalace as historian substrate (wings/embeddings/temporal ER graph/sweep/search); resolves pattern-signature schema + cadence + per-agent scoping
Keep memory-kit distinct from MemPalace (present-slice markdown vs history-perspective binary store); adapter to run mempalace sweep on .claude/archive periodically
MemPalace pilot before commitment: install non-default location, create historian wing, sweep archive, sample pattern search against active plan, decide integration shape
Future tool epic-timeline: read-only chronological walk of epic-graph git history (reading the protocol arc)
Future tool roadmap-walker: project next epic from trajectory (separate tool or converge --horizon flag — open question 5)
Open questions: epic-graph traversal model (commit-walk vs derived semantic graph); promote-to-epic operator gating; MemPalace storage location; embedding-model offline verification
